name: 222. Bedrock Converse Claude tool-schema compatibility (tool-schema-compat)
description: Claude on Bedrock rejects oneOf/anyOf/allOf at the root of a tool input_schema ("input_schema does not support oneOf, allOf, or anyOf at the top level"). Folder 99 pins the Anthropic converter, which bedrock_mantle and the Bedrock InvokeModel egress reuse; Bedrock's default Converse egress forwarded toolSpec.inputSchema verbatim, so Codex tools like automation_update failed on bedrock/ but not on bedrock_mantle/. Every inbound route that reaches Converse for Claude is covered: /v1/responses, /openai/v1/responses streaming (Codex's route), /v1/chat/completions, /anthropic/v1/messages, and the native /bedrock converse and invoke routes. The raw_request cases pin the flattened wire schema; the branch-limit case pins the gateway-side 400; the Nova case pins that non-Claude Converse models keep the root composition, which they accept.
